# This phrasing is slightly ambiguous. "Last day" usually means the maximum date in the set,

# This implies we should take the date from the last row of the specified range (A11).

# "Extract the number of the last day" -> This means the day of the month (e.g., if it's 2024-01-15, the result is 15).
last_day_number = last_date_obj.day

print(f"Last date in range: {last_date_obj}")
print(f"Day number: {last_day_number}")

# 3. Write
# Use openpyxl to modify only cell B1
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb.active # Assuming Sheet1 is the active sheet

# B1 is row 1, column 2
ws['B1'] = last_day_number

# 4. Verify & Save
# Ensure no formulas are written and only B1 is changed.
